title: Bill to track emergency donations deferred
summary: On October 20, the committee reviewed three bills on emergency donations, and a member moved to recommend Bill 142 for passage on first reading before the chair called a recess to fix amendment wording. Bill 142 would let the mayor accept and use disaster donations during an emergency and for a year after without prior council approval. The budget director said the administration supports the revised bills, which include mandatory quarterly reports to the council.
